note: THE CAP IS A RATE, not a total (2026-09-01). A frozen total punishes capability and cannot see density: ten new ports pushed the payload past its ceiling while the cost PER TOOL fell from 324.24 to 321.83. Carried in hundredths as an integer (32183 = 321.83 bytes/tool) because the determinism law refuses rounding helpers. The RATE may only shrink; the total may grow with the tool count. tools/list is names+descriptions+schemas, never detail.
